title: Is the water safe to drink?
scenario: Drinking water safety after the earthquake. Tap water may be contaminated, broken water mains, boil water advisory.
steps: After a major quake, assume tap water may be unsafe until officials say otherwise.
Use bottled water first if you have it.
If you must use tap water, boil it vigorously for 1 full minute and let it cool.
If you cannot boil: add 8 drops of plain, unscented household bleach per gallon of clear water, stir, and wait 30 minutes.
Your water heater tank and toilet TANK (not bowl) hold tens of gallons of usable emergency water.
Listen for official boil-water notices before returning to normal use.
do_not: Do not drink water that is dark, smells bad, or has floating material.
Do not use scented or color-safe bleach for disinfection.
